text: A plan you have never practised is a wish with bullet points.
note: Do one thing from your plan today — open the box, read the label, walk the route.

text: The cheapest water you will ever store is the water already in your pipes.
note: Fill the bathtub and every clean container the moment the power goes, not on day two.

text: Nobody panics about the thing they already know how to do.
note: Competence is the sedative. Practise the small tasks so the big day feels familiar.
